hello.speaker: MRS. IYER
hello.text: Arre, the new watchman? Good, good. Iyer, 2C. A courier came for me in the evening, no?

choices.text: Did you know Kishan? The old watchman.

find.speaker: MRS. IYER
find.text: It'll be in the cabin. Kishan always kept them on the floor by the window.

kishan.speaker: MRS. IYER
kishan.text: Nice man. Last week he started sitting with that CCTV all night. Said someone on the D wing terrace was filming him.

kishan2.speaker: MRS. IYER
kishan2.text: Then one morning his chair was empty. Anyway.

redlight.speaker: MRS. IYER
redlight.text: And tell the man on the D wing terrace to switch off his little red light. It blinks right into my bedroom.

choices.text: Nobody is allowed on the terraces at night.

nobody.speaker: MRS. IYER
nobody.text: Then who keeps waving at me?

after.speaker: MRS. IYER
after.text: Go, go. Do your rounds. And that red light, okay?
